1.peak_basis: One Blackhole p300c ASIC:120 physical cores at1.35GHz,4096 FLOP/cycle/core divided by4 for HiFi4;512GB/s DRAM. Runtime compute grid110 cores. No multi-device aggregation.
1.traffic_assumptions: BF16 dense weights once per independent batch plane of the [B,1,H] matmul geometry; FP32 recurrent state and physically padded BF16 convolution state read/write, residual input/output. Excludes intermediate spills, repeated reads within a plane and small norms/gates: estimated lower-bound traffic, not measured bus utilization.
1.flops_assumptions: Dense active work, no MoE/sparsity;2 FLOPs per multiply/add; causal attention pairs or recurrent updates plus approximate scalar norms/gates/activation work. Scalar transcendentals counted as one operation. No padding counted as useful work.
1.source: single-layer Tracy; whole-layer device firmware timestamp envelope including gaps
